subject: Moodle (VLE) upgrade notice! 11/9/2024
body:
Dear students,

We have a scheduled *upgrade* of our *GCET VLE (Moodle) platform* from 11
September to 15 September 2024. During this time, the VLE site may not be
available to users.

No action is required from your side.


Thank you for your patience and cooperation.



--
